tips.text: Buy as many Grustrag Three Beacons as you can whenever Baro stocks them; it is the one real speedup.
Bring Nekros with Desecrate to multiply the Three's drops.
Set your syndicate standing to neutral first; negative-standing death squads and the Stalker take the Three's spawn slot.
Farm with friends or clanmates who also hold the mark; each marked player raises the spawn chance.
Run Ceres in normal mode, not Steel Path, so Acolytes do not crash the farm.
Check the 5-minute window with the P mission menu and stand at extract after the objective.
Skip Clem's weekly mission; it spawns one member that drops nothing.
Avoid Survival, Interception and Defense; the Three can stop the timed rewards or bug out.
Watch for the Three spawning in unreachable areas after elevator or door triggers; that kills them and wastes the drops.
Redo the five Corpus-side Invasions straight after the Three attack, since the mark is spent.
Expect a slog: one full set can take about 30 hours, and the last part can take years.
Players who skipped Baro's beacons and ground it manually regret it.
